title: leighia
intro: Leighia, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Leighia include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Leighia include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it effective in treating wounds, skin irritations, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Leighia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
